description: Watchman at the ward gate, fourth ward east of the West Market. Sixties. Sits all day out of the wind with a brazier he considers his personal property.
knows: that he knocked at the Geng gate at the second drum and was refused
that he is not a harmless confused old man, and let him back into the ward anyway
that his own heart is failing, because Xu Ping told him plainly
that Xu Ping has the collar band of Geng Su's robe, got by way of a seamstress
that the green on it is the smell that comes off the Geng house
last_seen: his gate at the dawn drum on the fifth day
name: Tang
not_knows: that Xu Ping knelt at the Geng east wall and put his hands in the gutter
observed_not_explained: Set out a second stool before being asked.

Did his conscript service on the Juyan line in his twenties. Says the green is the smell of the western traders' camp there: something they burned at night in a clay pot. The soldiers said it was for sickness, or for the dead; he is not sure which. He never knew what it was called.
owes_owed: Xu Ping told him what the swelling in his ankles means and what to do about it, and took nothing for it

promises.what: if it comes to pain at the end, Xu Ping will see that it does not hurt

toward_player: Warm, and uneasier than before. Smelled the collar band and said where he had met the smell, then asked Xu Ping not to bring the dead man's clothes to his gate again. Is sleeping propped and has given up the salt fish, and says so. Told Pei the truth about him.
voice: Circles back to his own feet from any subject in under three sentences.
